source.snippet: Looking for something to track feature requests. Able to upload docs, zips, images. Free or one time low cost. Run on Windows, browser accessible.

problem_statement: Small software teams and solo developers need a lightweight, self-hostable or one-time-purchase feature request tracker that supports file attachments, without committing to SaaS subscription pricing.
target_segment: Solo developers, small ISVs, and Windows-centric software teams managing customer feature requests on limited budgets.
notes: Explicit price sensitivity ('free or one time low cost') signals a buyer who has evaluated SaaS options and rejected them on cost grounds. One-time-purchase or self-hosted feedback tools are an underserved niche — most incumbents (Canny, UserVoice) are subscription SaaS at $50-500/month. A $49 lifetime deal product could convert well here.
